title.narrative: Feed the Future Cambodia Harvest III

description.narrative: (Cambodia): .The Feed the Future Cambodia Harvest III activity promotes sustainable, broad-based economic growth through increased diversification and competitiveness in Cambodia's agriculture sector. Through private sector engagement within key agriculture market systems, the activity creates jobs, increases livelihoods, and improves diets and well-being for Cambodians, especially women, youth, and marginalized populations. The activity provides targeted demand-driven support to agricultural cooperatives, farmer associations, market actors, financial institutions, and/or micro, small and medium enterprises investing to take advantage of domestic, regional, and international market opportunities. Furthermore, the activity also engages the private sector in activities that focus on integrating climate-smart agriculture approaches and solar green energy to increase food security and reduce the vulnerability of production loss from climate stress...The activity is exploring partnership opportunities with U.S. firms to expand market access and sourcing requirements including the possibility of U.S.-Cambodian joint ventures that can contribute to developing a skilled workforce and increase job creation in the United States and Cambodia. Abt Associates Inc implements the activity and USAID awarded this activity through a competitive process in which the offeror with the best value to the U.S. government was selected, in accordance with federal procurement regulations..The activity supports the administration's "Growing economic opportunities" priority, specifically in agriculture by promoting improved supply chains, leveraging private sector partnerships, and supporting climate-smart agriculture technologies. This activity contributes to achieving USAID/Cambodia's CDCS 2020-2025 DO1, "Inclusive and sustainable economic growth broadened" by promoting market-based trade and competitiveness within the agriculture sector supporting IPS.
